# OpenCaptions

> OpenCaptions is free, open-source software (AGPL-3.0) that adds animated, word-by-word captions to videos. It transcribes speech with the model you choose (Whisper, Parakeet or Apple Speech), on an iPhone or on your own server, and exports a captioned video (MP4, WebM or ProRes), SRT or VTT subtitle files, or captions on a green screen.

Key facts:

- Open source under AGPL-3.0. Self-hosted with Docker Compose: download one `docker-compose.yml` and run `docker compose up -d`. A GPU is optional.
- An iPhone and iPad app transcribes on the device. No account is needed.
- No tracking and no analytics. Videos stay on the device or on your own server unless you choose another transcription provider.
- One Rust engine draws the captions in the browser (WebAssembly), on the server and on the iPhone, so the preview is the export.
- Speech models: Whisper covers about 100 spoken languages, Parakeet is fast in 25 European languages, and Apple Speech is built into iOS. Captions can be drawn in Latin, Cyrillic, Arabic, Hebrew, Indic, Thai and CJK scripts; the interface is available in 13 languages.
- The iPhone app is free to use, with an optional one-time Pro purchase and no subscription.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://docs.opencaptions.app/): the guides, self-hosting, the HTTP API and the reference (its own llms.txt: https://docs.opencaptions.app/llms.txt)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/README.md): features and quick start
- [Quick start](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): run it with one Docker Compose file
- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/self-hosting/installation.md): requirements, services, data, scaling and updates
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/self-hosting/configuration.md): every setting and its default
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/self-hosting/security.md): what to change before exposing it
- [HTTP API](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/reference/api.md): upload, transcribe, export, from a script
- [Design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/project/architecture.md): the services, the caption engine and the iOS app
- [Speech models](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/docs/project/speech-model-benchmarks.md): the speech models that were measured, and the one chosen
- [Privacy policy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leogaudin/opencaptions/main/PRIVACY.md)
